title: HelloKhata - AI-Powered Business Management Platform
description: An AI-powered business management platform that streamlines accounting, sales, purchases, inventory, customer management, and financial transactions. Built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern full-stack technologies to deliver intelligent insights, automation, and a seamless user experience.

title: LavEnterprise - Modern eCommerce Platform
description: A modern and responsive eCommerce platform built to deliver a seamless online shopping experience. Features include product catalog management, category-based browsing, secure checkout, shopping cart, order management, user authentication, and a clean, mobile-friendly interface optimized for performance and scalability.

title: Tech Gear-Full Stack E-commerce Dashboard
description: Tech Gear is a modern e-commerce platform designed for selling the latest gadgets and accessories. Built with React.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, it offers a fast, responsive, and secure shopping experience.
